products.title: Omega-3 Joint Support
products.shortDescription: Omega-3 nutrition for the joints your senior dog relies on to stand up, turn corners and join you on walks.
details: Use alongside: their regular food and activity plan
Watch at home: their first steps after a nap

content.heading: For the walk they still ask for
content.text: A familiar route gives you a point of comparison. Watch the first few steps after a nap and how freely your dog turns toward home. Omega-3 Joint Support brings joint nutrition into that everyday routine.

content.heading: Why omega-3s matter
content.text: EPA and DHA are the omega-3 fats studied in canine joint care. When you compare labels, look for the amount of each in a daily serving. The total weight of fish oil alone tells you less.

content.heading: See what changes over a week
content.text: Watch your dog on the same short stretch of level ground. Compare their stride and where they choose to stop. A familiar route makes small changes easier to describe.

content.heading: Daily serving
content.text: Feeding guide: Use the daily serving on your WoafyPet package for your dog’s weight. If you already give fish oil or feed an omega-3-enriched diet, count those sources when planning their intake.

products.title: Gut Support
products.shortDescription: Everyday digestive support for senior dogs, built around their usual meals and a simple sign of gut health: consistently formed stools.
details: Use alongside: the food your dog already tolerates
Watch at home: stool firmness on their usual walks

content.heading: Start with the bowl they know
content.text: For an older dog with a well-established appetite, mealtime is a natural place to build digestive care into the day. Keep the bowl and feeding time familiar.

content.heading: The next walk tells you more
content.text: A formed stool that’s easy to pick up is a practical sign of normal digestion. Notice changes in firmness and how often your dog needs to go out, especially after a change in food.

content.heading: Keep the rest of dinner familiar
content.text: Use the same food and treats as you introduce digestive support. A sudden menu change can upset digestion and make it hard to tell which change your dog tolerated.

content.heading: Daily serving
content.text: Feeding guide: Use the daily amount printed on the WoafyPet package. If your dog follows a prescribed diet, check the ingredient panel against that diet before adding the supplement.

products.title: Skin & Coat Support
products.shortDescription: Daily nutritional support for healthy skin and a well-conditioned coat, from the fur behind their ears to the skin under their collar.
details: Nutritional goal: healthy skin and coat
Use alongside: a complete diet and regular brushing
Watch at home: flakes or rough patches during brushing

content.heading: Care for the skin under the fur
content.text: Nutrition helps maintain the skin barrier that holds moisture in. At brushing time, part the fur behind the ears and under the collar to see whether the skin looks smooth or flaky.

content.heading: Notice changes between baths
content.text: Run a hand down their back after towel-drying. New flakes, a rough patch or repeated licking in one spot are easier to spot when you know what their coat normally feels like.

content.heading: Pair nutrition with regular brushing
content.text: Brushing works through loose hair at the surface. Food supplies the nutrients for the skin and hair growing underneath. Keep both parts of the routine consistent.

content.heading: Daily serving
content.text: Feeding guide: Measure the daily amount listed on your WoafyPet package for your dog. Compare the ingredients with any coat or fish-oil supplements they already take before combining them.
